goal.en: Choose confidently between the past simple, present perfect and present perfect continuous.
goal.ar: أن تختار بثقة بين الماضي البسيط والمضارع التام والمضارع التام المستمر.

job.title: From a job application
job.text: I graduated from Cairo University in 2019 and have worked in digital marketing ever since. For the last two years I have been managing a small team at a start-up, where I have designed campaigns for clients across the Gulf. Last spring I completed a certificate in data analytics, and I have recently started studying for a second one. I am now looking for a role where I can take on more responsibility.

text.en: Past simple = a finished time, and often a specific one (yesterday, in 2019, last spring). Present perfect = a time period that includes now (today, this year, ever, so far).
text.ar: الماضي البسيط لزمن منتهٍ ومحدد غالباً مثل in 2019، والمضارع التام لفترة ما زالت مفتوحة تشمل الآن مثل this year وso far.

items.en: I lived in Doha for five years. (I don't live there now.)
items.ar: عشت في الدوحة خمس سنوات — ولم أعد أعيش هناك.

items.en: I have lived in Doha for five years. (I still live there.)
items.ar: أعيش في الدوحة منذ خمس سنوات — وما زلت.

items.en: Did you see the news this morning? (the morning is over)
items.ar: هل رأيت الأخبار هذا الصباح؟ — الصباح انتهى.

items.en: Have you seen the news today? (today is still going)
items.ar: هل رأيت الأخبار اليوم؟ — اليوم لم ينتهِ بعد.

text.en: News is often announced in the present perfect, then the details continue in the past simple: “A fire has broken out… It started at 3 a.m.”
text.ar: تُعلن الأخبار غالباً بالمضارع التام ثم تُروى تفاصيلها بالماضي البسيط: A fire has broken out… It started at 3 a.m.

text.en: for + a length of time (for three years, for ten minutes). since + a starting point (since 2019, since Monday, since I moved here).
text.ar: for مع مدة زمنية مثل for three years، وsince مع نقطة بداية مثل since 2019.

text.en: “I am here since Monday” is wrong. A situation that started in the past and continues needs the perfect: “I have been here since Monday.”
text.ar: لا نقول I am here since Monday. الوضع الذي بدأ في الماضي واستمر يحتاج المضارع التام: I have been here since Monday.

text.en: have/has been + -ing emphasises the activity and its duration; the simple perfect emphasises the completed result.
text.ar: have been + ing تركّز على النشاط ومدته، بينما المضارع التام البسيط يركّز على النتيجة المكتملة.

items.en: I have been reading this book. (activity, maybe not finished)
items.ar: ظللت أقرأ هذا الكتاب — نشاط قد لا يكون انتهى.

items.en: I have read this book. (finished — I know it)
items.ar: قرأت هذا الكتاب — انتهى وأعرف محتواه.

items.en: She's been working here since March.

text.en: State verbs (know, be, own, believe) stay simple: “I have known him for years”, not “have been knowing”.
text.ar: أفعال الحالة مثل know وown تبقى في الصيغة البسيطة: I have known him for years.

explanation.en: A specific finished year → past simple.
explanation.ar: سنة محددة منتهية، فنستخدم الماضي البسيط.

questions.sentence: We ___ three meetings so far this week.

explanation.en: “So far this week” is an unfinished period → present perfect.
explanation.ar: «حتى الآن هذا الأسبوع» فترة لم تنتهِ، فنستخدم المضارع التام.

prompt.en: Which sentence suggests the person no longer works there?
prompt.ar: أي جملة توحي بأن الشخص لم يعد يعمل هناك؟

options: He worked at the bank for ten years.
He has worked at the bank for ten years.
He has been working at the bank for ten years.

explanation.en: The past simple closes the period; the perfect forms keep it open to now.
explanation.ar: الماضي البسيط يُغلق الفترة، أما صيغ التام فتُبقيها متصلة بالحاضر.

explanation.en: A specific past date cannot go with the present perfect.
explanation.ar: لا يجتمع تاريخ ماضٍ محدد مع المضارع التام.

explanation.en: Tuesday is a starting point → since.

questions.sentence: They have known each other ___ many years.

explanation.en: “Many years” is a length of time → for.

options: I have been working here since 2020.

explanation.en: A situation running from the past to now needs a perfect form, not the present continuous.
explanation.ar: الوضع الممتد من الماضي إلى الآن يحتاج صيغة التام لا المضارع المستمر.

commonMistake.en: Arabic uses the present with «منذ», so “I am here since…” feels natural — but English requires the perfect.
commonMistake.ar: العربية تستخدم المضارع مع «منذ»، فيسهل الوقوع في I am here since. الإنجليزية توجب صيغة التام.

explanation.en: Present evidence of a recent, continuing activity → present perfect continuous.
explanation.ar: أثر حاضر لنشاط قريب ممتد، فنستخدم المضارع التام المستمر.

prompt.en: Which sentence tells you the book is finished?
prompt.ar: أي جملة تدل على أن الكتاب انتهى؟

options: I have been reading that book.
I read that book for an hour.

explanation.en: The simple perfect focuses on the completed result; the continuous focuses on the activity.
explanation.ar: التام البسيط يركّز على النتيجة المكتملة، والمستمر يركّز على النشاط نفسه.

options: I have been waiting for an hour.
I have been knowing him for years.
She has been studying all day.
They have known each other since school.

explanation.en: “Know” is a state verb and has no continuous form: I have known him for years.
explanation.ar: know من أفعال الحالة فلا تأتي في المستمر. الصواب I have known him for years.

prompt.en: Which statement is true about the writer?

options: They still work in digital marketing.
They have never worked with Gulf clients.
They finished the analytics certificate this month.

explanation.en: “Have worked … ever since” connects 2019 to now, so the work continues.
explanation.ar: عبارة have worked… ever since تصل ٢٠١٩ بالحاضر، فالعمل مستمر.

prompt.en: Why does the writer use “have been managing” rather than “managed”?
prompt.ar: لماذا استخدم الكاتب have been managing بدل managed؟

options: The role is ongoing and its duration matters.
The role finished two years ago.
It is more formal than the past simple.

explanation.en: The perfect continuous keeps the activity open and stresses “for the last two years”.
explanation.ar: التام المستمر يُبقي النشاط مفتوحاً ويُبرز المدة «خلال العامين الماضيين».

prompt.en: Why is “completed” in the past simple?
prompt.ar: لماذا جاء الفعل completed في الماضي البسيط؟

explanation.en: A specific finished time (“last spring”) forces the past simple, even in a paragraph full of perfects.
explanation.ar: الزمن المحدد المنتهي «الربيع الماضي» يفرض الماضي البسيط، حتى في فقرة تكثر فيها صيغ التام.

prompt.en: Rewrite with “for”: “I have been here since 9 o'clock.” (It is now 11 o'clock.)
prompt.ar: أعد الصياغة باستخدام for: I have been here since 9 o'clock والساعة الآن ١١.

questions.answer: i have been here for two hours
accept: i've been here for two hours
i have been here for 2 hours

explanation.en: “Since” takes the starting point; “for” takes the length: two hours.
explanation.ar: since تأخذ نقطة البداية، وfor تأخذ المدة: ساعتان.

questions.answer: How long have you been learning English

explanation.en: “How long” + present perfect continuous asks about duration up to now.
explanation.ar: How long مع التام المستمر تسأل عن المدة حتى اللحظة.
